newsitem.title: POLAND: NBP drains PLN 968 mln from Polish money market.
newsitem.headline: NBP drains PLN 968 mln from Polish money market.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland drained 849 million zlotys from the market for three days through a reverse NBP-bill repurchase auction after banks bid to place 1,178 million with the central bank, the NBP said.
The central bank also drained 119 million for 14 days after banks bid to place 119 million.
The bank drained the market for three days at a maximum rate of 22.45 percent and an average rate of 22.42 percent.
The 14-day drainage maximum and average rates eased 0.01 point to 22.58 percent.
